system.description:
your weapon group gives you its own manoeuvre, used once per round as part of a hit with a weapon of that group (still one rider per hit). Every weapon's group is in the Group column of the weapon tables (the Shopkeeper's Catalogue and Basic Weapons in Character Creation); a magic weapon is in its base weapon's group, and for a weapon on no table the GM picks the closest group:

    • Bind (blades): make a Disarm contest against the target.
    • Hew (chopping and crushing): a creature your size or smaller makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or is knocked Prone.
    • Hook (reach and tangling): make a Trip contest against the target, at your weapon's full reach.
    • Pinning Fire (missiles): the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll. Thrown melee weapons (dagger, hand axe, spear) stay in their melee group.
    • Clinch (fist weapons): on a hit, make a Grapple contest against the target.
    • Shield Guard: instead of your group's manoeuvre, you may take this when you choose your group. While you carry a shield, once per round when you hit, the first attack against you or an adjacent ally before your next turn has Disadvantage.
